notes.title: Update on the Release of Designated Driver
notes.notes: [p][b]Announcement: Update on the Release of [i]Designated Driver[/i][/b][/p][p]To our valued gamers who have been waiting for [i]Designated Driver[/i], we sincerely apologize for the delay in the release.[/p][p]During the final stages of testing, we discovered areas that required further improvements and decided to include additional development work. To provide a better experience, we are also expanding support to include more languages.[/p][p]We are now aiming to launch within October, and we truly appreciate your patience and support as we work to deliver the best possible version of [i]Designated Driver[/i].[/p]
